hypothesis: The complete v25 live portfolio can produce mechanically valid protected lifecycles while causal execution, missed-opportunity, orderbook, and provider-clock telemetry identifies repeatable provider-symbol behavior that clears measured live friction.
decision: Keep v25 armed and unchanged. Record one exact BTC HT-Breakout long episode as negative report-only entry-quality evidence: its executable-BBO path was -11.6131, -15.6198, and -19.0101 bps after modeled friction at 15, 30, and 60 minutes. The episode had aligned order pressure but neutral 5m and 15m context. No live lifecycle resolved in the same-run delta and no new provider evaluation became eligible. Continue collecting independent both-side episodes and resolved live outcomes; do not route, resize, gate, pause, or alter v25 from one path.
falsifier: This revision is invalidated by source-run or profile drift, changed artifact bytes, a pre-publication BBO, incomplete path identity, inconsistent fee or slippage arithmetic, or report-only code changing runtime state. The entry-quality concern would weaken if materially more independent BTC long and short episodes retain positive after-friction median and leave-largest results and agree with resolved live lifecycles.
limitations: The BTC observation is one long episode from one intraday window; there is no short-side replication or regime diversity.
Executable-BBO markouts model visible top-of-book capacity, fees, and residual slippage but cannot reproduce private latency, hidden liquidity, or queue position.
The episode is signal-path evidence, not a submitted order, fill, funding result, owned PnL, or shared-capital portfolio replay.
The broader opportunity stream is highly overlapping; raw matured annotations must not be counted as independent trials.
Provider metric telemetry remains incomplete under the known loaded pre-repair runtime; the technical-gap identity did not change in this delta.
Three live lifecycles remained provisional at the audit cutoff, so their marked economics are excluded from resolved performance.
No live route, position, order, stop, target, size, exit, transition drain, or protection changed in this revision.
